steps.text: Talk to Bert in west Yanille.
choices: Eww a hand, in the sand! Why haven't you told the authorities?
Sure, I'll give you a hand.

steps.text: Give the Guard Captain in the pub south of Bert a beer. You can buy one for 2gp from the pub.
Ring the bell outside the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. Talk to Zavistic Rarve when he appears.
choices: I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.

steps.text: Return to Bert in west Yanille.
Travel to Brimhaven, then enter Sandy's building south of the restaurant. Search Sandy's desk for Sandy's rota.
Pickpocket Sandy for some sand.
Return to Bert in west Yanille with the rota and sand.
Ring the bell outside the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. Talk to Zavistic Rarve when he appears.
choices: I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.

steps.text: Talk to Zavistic Rarve again to get teleported to Port Sarim.
choices: I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.

steps.text: Travel to Port Sarim, and talk to Betty in the magic shop.
choices: Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.

steps.text: Use redberries on the bottled water.
Use whiteberries on the red bottled water
Use the pink dye on a lantern lens.
Talk to Betty with the pink lens.
choices: Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.

steps.text: Stand in Betty's doorway and use the rose-tinted lens on the counter.
Stand in Betty's doorway and use the rose-tinted lens on the counter.
Talk to Betty again.
choices: Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.

steps.text: Talk to Sandy in Brimhaven again with the truth serum. Select distractions until one works.
Use the truth serum on Sandy's coffee mug.
Activate the magical orb next to Sandy.
Ask Sandy all questions available with the Magical orb (a) in your inventory.
choices: Why is Bert's rota different from the original?
Why doesn't Bert remember the change in his hours?

steps.text: Return to the Wizards' Guild in Yanille and ring the bell outside. Talk to Zavistic Rarve when he appears.
choices: I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.

steps.text: Give Zavistic Rarve 5 earth runes and a bucket of sand.
choices: I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.

steps.text: Travel to Entrana (bank all combat gear), and talk to Mazion at the sand pit.
Return to the Wizards' Guild in Yanille and ring the bell outside. Talk to Zavistic Rarve when he appears to finish the quest.
choices: I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.

rewards: Daily sand from Bert in Yanille.
Access to the Wizards Guild rune store.
